    digits = list(str(num))
    n = len(digits)
    
    # Step 1: Find the rightmost digit that can be part of a larger number
    k = n - 1
    while k > 0 and digits[k] <= digits[k - 1]:
        k -= 1
    if k == 0:
        return -1  # No such digit found

    l = n - 1
    while digits[l] <= digits[k]:

    digits = digits[:k + 1] + digits[k + 1:][::-1]
